answer: Proposal: a zephyr draw selects hidden grading traps; each seat signs a plume of verdicts. Validators reveal a planted invalid signature; a falcon verifier slashes seats that approved it. Each seat locks N times its capped payout in distinct coins for 30 epochs when N seats are active; nullifiers prevent reuse. A farm can share one model and borrow bonds, but k seats need at least k² payout-units locked when N>=k; lenders cannot lend the same locked coin twice and price loss risk. Skip the lock and validators deny the seat. This is a proposed rule, not MinePoA policy.
